sources: https://www.space-track.org/documentation (FAQ 'What is Alpha-5?' and TLE page 'Alpha 5' section; read 2026-09-20)
CelesTrak GP formats FAQ (CelesTrak itself does not emit Alpha-5): https://celestrak.org/NORAD/documentation/gp-data-formats.php
rule: Objects 100000-339999: first character is a letter with value 10-33 (A=10, B=11, ... skipping I and O ... Z=33) followed by the last four digits. Objects below 100000: five digits, leading zeros retained. Alpha-5 appears only in TLE/3LE columns 3-7 of lines 1 and 2; OMM NORAD_CAT_ID is always an integer.

checksum_note: In a TLE checksum the Alpha-5 letter counts 0 (letters, blanks, periods and plus signs count 0; minus signs count 1), per Space-Track and CelesTrak.
